cards.title: Images with
cards.body: `` shows a picture. `src` is the address of the picture. It has no closing tag.

hi.title: se images
hi.body: `` ek picture dikhata hai. `src` picture ka address hai. Iska koi closing tag nahi hota.

cards.title: Always write alt text
cards.body: `alt` describes the picture for people who can't see it, and shows when the picture fails to load.

hi.title: Hamesha alt text likho
hi.body: `alt` picture ko un logon ke liye describe karta hai jo use dekh nahi sakte, aur tab dikhta hai jab picture load nahi hoti.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The picture shows, but the page breaks a rule from this lesson. Which line?

bug.fix: Every image needs `alt` text for people who can't see it, like ``.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Picture dikhti hai, par page is lesson ka ek rule todta hai. Kaunsi line?
hi.fix: Har image ko `alt` text chahiye un logon ke liye jo dekh nahi sakte, jaise ``.

check.question: What is `alt` for?
options: Describing the picture for people who can't see it
check.explanation: Screen readers read the `alt` text aloud, and browsers show it when the picture is missing.

hi.question: `alt` kis liye hai?
options: Jo log dekh nahi sakte unke liye picture describe karna
hi.explanation: Screen readers `alt` text bol kar padhte hain, aur picture missing ho toh browsers use dikhate hain.

exercise.prompt: Add an image with any `src`, and an `alt` that describes it.
exercise.promptHi: Koi bhi `src` wali ek image jodo, aur ek `alt` jo use describe kare.
